description: Chest X-ray preprocessing for the TB model (TRD 9.3, 10.6). The app must reproduce these steps exactly; ml/train/preprocess.py is the reference implementation.
steps: decode the image and convert to 8-bit grayscale (PIL mode 'L', ITU-R 601-2 luma)
scale so the longer side is input_size, keeping the aspect ratio, with bilinear resampling
paste centred on an input_size x input_size canvas filled with pad_value
copy the grayscale channel to 3 channels
divide by 255, then subtract mean and divide by std per channel
